title: Cardiovascular prediction: study tasks, cohorts and validation
question: How do these studies support heart-failure prognosis, biomarker interpretation and evaluation planning for cardiovascular AI?
scope: Compare three author-maintained evidence summaries for heart-failure prognosis and clinical AI research. This guide brings each paper’s reported task, population, endpoints, validation design and source-linked findings together for literature selection and Discussion writing.
reading_rule: Start with the contribution that matches your research question, then use the reported population, endpoint and validation design to choose the citation. The three roles here are external survival-model evaluation, admission-marker associations, and methodological planning for clinician–AI workflows.

studies.title: AI hybrid survival assessment for advanced heart failure patients with renal dysfunction

study_profile.population: Adults with advanced heart failure and renal dysfunction

selected_questions.question: What is AIHFLevel?
selected_questions.answer: AIHFLevel is an explainable 12-predictor survival-risk assessment system developed for patients with advanced heart failure and renal dysfunction.

supporting_evidence.claim: The selected hybrid modeling strategy achieved the highest average C-index among evaluated schemes.
supporting_evidence.context: Comprehensive evaluation of 132 candidate modeling schemes
supporting_evidence.source_locator: Results: Survival assessment system AIHFLevel; Fig. 2b

selected_questions.question: Was AIHFLevel externally validated?
selected_questions.answer: Yes. AIHFLevel was independently evaluated in 1,024 patients from BIDMC.

supporting_evidence.claim: AIHFLevel retained prognostic discrimination in an independent BIDMC external cohort.

supports: Mortality-risk estimation in the studied advanced-heart-failure and renal-dysfunction population.
Internal and independent external evaluation of AIHFLevel.
Association between higher AIHFLevel and poorer prognosis.
does_not_establish: That AIHFLevel-guided treatment improves survival or other clinical outcomes.
That predictors included in AIHFLevel are causal determinants of mortality.
That model performance is identical in every healthcare setting or population.

limitations: The study was retrospective and observational.
Prospective multicenter validation is still warranted.
Randomized studies would be required to establish whether AIHFLevel-guided treatment improves patient outcomes.
Some echocardiographic predictors may not be uniformly available in primary-care settings.
Direct methodological reproduction of every comparator risk model was not possible.

studies.task: Admission TyG and subsequent HF outcomes
studies.title: TYG Index as a Novel Predictor of Clinical Outcomes in Advanced Chronic Heart Failure with Renal Dysfunction Patients

study_profile.study_design: Retrospective single-center observational cohort; admissions from September 2019 through December 2020, with follow-up completed in March 2022
study_profile.evidence_type: Admission laboratory biomarker association with longitudinal outcomes, using outcome-derived ROC thresholds, Cox regression and Kaplan-Meier analyses
study_profile.population: Adults with advanced chronic heart failure, eGFR below 90 mL/min/1.73 m², and at least two heart-failure hospitalizations at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University; 717 analyzed after 98 losses among 815 initially included
study_profile.primary_endpoint: Reported MACEs composite: cardiovascular or non-cardiovascular death, worsening-HF rehospitalization, heart transplantation, mechanical circulatory support, malignant arrhythmia, myocardial infarction, or unstable-angina rehospitalization; this is broader than a conventional three-point MACE endpoint
study_profile.secondary_endpoint: All-cause mortality during follow-up; reported median follow-up 21.58 months (interquartile range 17.98–25.39)
data_modalities: Admission fasting triglyceride and glucose measurements
Clinical laboratory values and medication history

cohorts.name: Analyzed single-center cohort
cohorts.role: Same cohort used for threshold selection, association estimation and outcome assessment

selected_questions.question: What was the reported MACEs association?
selected_questions.answer: High versus low TyG at the 8.48 threshold had an adjusted hazard ratio of 5.402 (95% CI 3.771–7.739). This is a relative hazard association, not an absolute event rate.

supporting_evidence.claim: A TyG cutoff of 8.48 separated groups with different composite-event risks, with moderate discrimination in the source cohort.
supporting_evidence.context: The endpoint-specific cutoff and ROC performance were derived and evaluated in the same cohort; no independent external validation was reported.
supporting_evidence.source_locator: PMC11068055: Results — Baseline Characteristics; Figure 2; Table 1 (Clinical and Laboratory Characteristics According to the TyG (MACEs), anchor t0001).

supporting_evidence.claim: Higher TyG was associated with a higher adjusted hazard of the reported composite adverse-event endpoint.
supporting_evidence.context: The comparison is the high-TyG group versus the low-TyG group in an observational multivariable Cox model. The hazard ratio is not an absolute event probability or a treatment effect.

selected_questions.answer: The analysis included 717 adults with advanced chronic HF, study-defined renal dysfunction and repeated HF hospitalization at one center. The 815 initially included patients also contained 98 who were lost to follow-up.

supporting_evidence.context: This is an observational advanced-heart-failure population selected for renal dysfunction and repeated HF hospitalization; the initial included population is not the analyzed sample size.

selected_questions.answer: No. The two outcome-specific cutoffs regrouped the same 717 analyzed patients. Their group sizes must not be added together as independent participants.

selected_questions.answer: No. The Methods define a broad composite including non-cardiovascular death, worsening-HF rehospitalization, transplantation, circulatory support and other events. Interpretation should preserve that study-specific definition.

supports: A prognostic association between admission TyG and subsequent outcomes in this selected retrospective cohort.
Outcome-specific discrimination and hazard-ratio estimates under the study definitions and modeling choices.
does_not_establish: Causality between insulin resistance and the observed events.
That lowering triglyceride, glucose or TyG reduces mortality or rehospitalization.
External validity of the same thresholds, prospective clinical utility, or superiority to a validated clinical decision pathway.
A conventional three-point MACE endpoint: the study composite explicitly includes non-cardiovascular death and multiple HF-related outcomes.

limitations: Single-center retrospective selection and residual confounding restrict causal and transportability claims.
Thresholds were selected using the outcomes in the same dataset; no independent external validation was reported.
Ninety-eight initially included patients were lost to follow-up, which may introduce attrition bias.
The broad study-specific composite should not be treated as interchangeable with a standard three-point MACE outcome.
Some narrative table cross-references do not match the displayed table captions. This page locates adjusted MACEs and ACM estimates by the actual Table 5 and Table 6 titles and anchors.
A hazard ratio does not provide an absolute probability or demonstrate benefit from changing TyG.

research_use.question: What should be reported when comparing discrimination, calibration and external validation in heart failure models?
research_use.question_zh: 比较心衰模型区分度、校准度和外部验证时应报告哪些证据？
research_use.answer: Start with the clinical task: target population, care setting, prediction time, endpoint and horizon. Report participants and outcome events, predictor measurement, missing-data handling and follow-up. Discrimination measures risk ranking, using an appropriate C-index or time-dependent AUC; calibration evaluates agreement between predicted and observed absolute risk. Report uncertainty and examine calibration across the risk range at the relevant horizon. Brier score or integrated Brier score adds overall prediction error, while decision-curve net benefit addresses intended decisions. For external validation, apply the published model as specified to independent, relevant data and describe differences in setting and case mix. Report recalibration, refitting and updating separately. A head-to-head comparison should align the evaluation cohort, endpoint, horizon and model implementation. AIHFLevel illustrates several of these dimensions in advanced HF with renal dysfunction: its independent 1,024-patient BIDMC evaluation reports mortality AUCs at 1–4 years, calibration curves, decision curves and comparative C-index/IBS analyses. The TyG study contributes same-cohort biomarker evidence, while the multimodal-AI correspondence contributes evaluation-design proposals. The review Big Data and Trustworthy AI for Heart Failure cites AIHFLevel in its clinical-implementation discussion and Table 3, providing an entry point to the original study's cohort- and horizon-specific evaluation. In the original paper, the independent BIDMC cohort (n=1,024) has all-cause mortality AUCs of 0.788, 0.816, 0.824 and 0.846 at 1, 2, 3 and 4 years (Figure 6d), with calibration and decision curves in Figures 6e–f.
research_use.answer_zh: 先统一临床任务：人群、应用场景、预测起点、结局和时间窗，并报告样本数、事件数、预测变量测量、缺失处理与随访。区分度回答风险排序能力；校准度回答绝对风险是否与观察结果一致，应结合不确定性和相应时间窗的校准曲线阅读。Brier或IBS补充整体预测误差，决策曲线补充给定决策阈值下的净获益。外部验证应在独立相关数据上按原模型实施，另列再校准、重拟合和模型更新。AIHFLevel提供高级心衰合并肾功能异常的外部预后评估实例；TyG提供同队列标志物证据；多模态AI通信文章提供评估设计建议。《Big Data and Trustworthy AI for Heart Failure》在临床实施讨论及表3中引用AIHFLevel，为追读原论文具体队列和时间窗的评估结果提供了入口。原论文独立BIDMC队列（n=1,024）在1、2、3、4年全因死亡预测中的AUC分别为0.788、0.816、0.824和0.846（图6d），图6e–f进一步给出校准和决策曲线。

checklist.text: State the population, setting, prediction time, endpoint, horizon, participants/events, predictor availability, missingness and follow-up.
Name the C-index or time-dependent AUC definition, time horizon, uncertainty and survival-data handling.
Show observed versus predicted risk at the relevant horizon, with a calibration curve and appropriate numerical summaries and uncertainty.
Describe independent data and case mix, apply the original specified model, and identify any recalibration, refitting or updating separately.
Report Brier/IBS over a defined time window and, when relevant to intended use, decision curves over stated thresholds.

study_roles.text: AIHFLevel contributes a 12-predictor prognostic system with independent BIDMC evaluation. Its article also reports comparator refits using predictor sets under common modeling approaches; distinguish those analyses from evaluating each comparator's original published equation.

The TyG study connects an accessible admission metabolic marker to subsequent events in advanced HF with renal dysfunction; its ROC thresholds and association estimates come from the same analyzed cohort.

study_roles.role: Evaluation planning for incomplete and stale multimodal evidence
study_roles.text: The correspondence proposes intended-use-specific tests of missing inputs, co-missingness, temporal staleness and external data, alongside an explicit deferral pathway.

rows.endpoint: Study-defined broad MACEs and all-cause mortality; median follow-up 21.58 months.
rows.validation: ROC thresholds and associations estimated in the same analyzed cohort.
rows.metrics: Source-cohort ROC AUC 0.759 for broad MACEs and 0.700 for all-cause mortality.

rows.population: Methodological cardiovascular-AI context; no new empirical cohort.

research_use.comparison_note: Read the rows by their stated research role. Head-to-head model ranking requires aligned data, endpoints, horizons and implementations; predictive or decision-curve performance and clinical impact are different evaluations.

research_uses.text: Use the checklist to specify the target setting, independent evaluation data, calibration/discrimination measures, prediction-error summary and any model updating before analysis.

Use AIHFLevel for an external prognostic-evaluation example, TyG for admission-marker associations, and the correspondence for missingness/staleness evaluation planning, with each formal DOI tied to its actual contribution.
